snippet.title: AI’s next phase is about doing the work, not just answering questions
snippet.description: Pick one repetitive workflow this week — for example, meeting notes to draft email, customer research to brief, or weekly reporting — and test whether an AI tool can complete the first pass faster than your current process. Keep the task narrow and require human approval before anything is sent or published. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-your-most-ambitious-work/))Read the full brief: https://clearforge-daily-brief.netlify.app/posts/2026-07-11.html
